circular.title: Operator workshop and asset passports
circular.demo: For the operator, not the customer. Demo mode lets you act as workshop staff. Finishing a lease does not confirm that the item has physically arrived.
circular.imported: Earlier lives are imported summaries; their individual events are not available.
circular.matches: Eligible demand: earliest deadline, then stable request ID
circular.pendingApproval: Work is complete. The asset remains unavailable until company approval.
circular.rejected: Proposal rejected. The asset remains unavailable.
circular.emptyReturned: There are no submitted returns waiting for company operations.
circular.confirm: Confirm each completed task. Mandatory work cannot be skipped.
end.recorded: Settlement obligation recorded; payment is not recorded
end.policy: Early-return policy: at a monthly boundary, fee is the lower of remaining net rents and the signed end buyout. No admin fee. Ordinary end return is free; buyout is separate.
end.totalNet: Total net if bought at term end
end.taxHint: VAT is additional and can change; buyout is optional.
lease.underage: You must be at least 18 on the lease start date. You can explore the catalogue and apply when eligible.
lease.manualReview: A person needs to review this application before signing can continue.
circular.steps: 1. Receive the actual item and register its physical return. 2. Inspect its condition and usage. 3. Perform and confirm every required task. 4. Release an eligible item for another lease; otherwise send it for pricing review.
circular.empty: No lease test items yet. Complete a lease and choose Return to start.
circular.review: Workshop work saved. This item cannot be financed at its estimated net value and stays unavailable pending operator pricing review. Estimated value:
circular.conflict: This item or request has changed, or a required step is missing. Reload and check the return, inspection and required tasks before retrying.
